facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fog:FogUpdateFunc
facts.value: Animation-update callback with signature `void (void* obj, enum_t type, HSD_ObjData* val)`; `obj` is interpreted as `HSD_Fog*`, handled discriminator values are 1, 2, 5–8, and 20, and every handled attribute consumes the floating-point `val->fv` member.
facts.reason: Existing claim that every handled attribute consumes val->fv omits the null fog early return and type20 absent fog_adj guard; defer retained-fact replacement.

evidence.why: Treats obj as HSD_Fog*. Null fog no-op. Types 1/2 write start/end, 5..8 scale fv by 255 into RGBA, 20 writes s16 center only with adjustment. Unknown types ignored; no value clamps or pointer guard on handled value reads.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fog:HSD_FogAdjInit
facts.value: Prepares the per-fog projection and viewport parameters used by GX fog range adjustment, the horizontal screen-position correction layered on camera-relative depth fog. Its default path aligns the adjustment width and center to the currently installed camera viewport and supplies a neutral identity projection matrix.
facts.reason: Default assignments confirmed. Center=width/2 feeds a later formula with a +320 bias, so geometric centered/neutral wording needs GX coefficient review.

evidence.why: Null destination no-op. Descriptor copies width, converts unsigned descriptor center into signed destination center, and copies 48 matrix bytes. Null descriptor converts viewport width into u16, assigns width/2 to s16 center and explicitly completes identity fourth row.
Six paired-single loads/stores cover offsets 0 through 47 only; no fourth-row copy.
